heading.en: Dearness allowance and your family budget

hook.en: Government employees get dearness allowance when the consumer price index rises. What is this index, and how is it built from a family budget?
hook.kn: ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಬೆಲೆ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ ಏರಿದಾಗ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ನೌಕರರಿಗೆ ತುಟ್ಟಿಭತ್ಯೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ ಏನು, ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಬಜೆಟ್‌ನಿಂದ ಅದನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ರಚಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ?

objectives.en: Explain the meaning and construction of a CPI
Compute CPI by the aggregate expenditure and family budget methods
Use CPI for real wages and purchasing power

narration.en: Government employees get dearness allowance when the consumer price index rises. What is this index, and how is it built from a family budget?
narration.kn: ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಬೆಲೆ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ ಏರಿದಾಗ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ನೌಕರರಿಗೆ ತುಟ್ಟಿಭತ್ಯೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ ಏನು, ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಬಜೆಟ್‌ನಿಂದ ಅದನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ರಚಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ?

title.en: Consumer price index (cost of living index)

body.en: A consumer price index measures the average change in the retail prices of goods and services bought by a particular class of people (industrial workers, agricultural labourers, urban employees). Steps: decide the class and area, conduct a family budget enquiry to find the items and their weights, collect retail prices, and compute the index. Methods: aggregate expenditure method $\text{CPI} = \frac{\sum p_1 q_0}{\sum p_0 q_0} \times 100$, and family budget method $\text{CPI} = \frac{\sum IW}{\sum W}$, where $I = \frac{p_1}{p_0} \times 100$ and $W = p_0 q_0$ or the budget share.

points.en: Class of people and area are fixed first
Weights from a family budget enquiry
Both methods give the same answer when W = p₀q₀

narration.en: A consumer price index measures the change in the cost of living of one class of people. It is found by the aggregate expenditure method or by the family budget method, sigma I W over sigma W.
narration.kn: ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಬೆಲೆ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕವು ಒಂದು ವರ್ಗದ ಜನರ ಜೀವನ ವೆಚ್ಚದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಮಷ್ಟಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ವಿಧಾನ ಅಥವಾ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಬಜೆಟ್ ವಿಧಾನ ΣIW/ΣW ಮೂಲಕ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.

title.en: CPI by the family budget method

narration.en: The board computes a consumer price index by the family budget method and turns a money wage into a real wage.

say.en: Group indices I and budget weights W for five groups of a family budget.
Multiply each index by its weight, then add.
Divide the total of I W by the total of the weights.
A worker earning thirty-two thousand rupees now has a real wage of twenty thousand rupees at base prices.

body.en: Uses: fixing dearness allowance and wages; finding real wages: $\text{Real wage} = \frac{\text{Money wage}}{\text{CPI}} \times 100$; purchasing power of the rupee $= \frac{100}{\text{CPI}}$; deflating values; framing price policy.

narration.en: The C P I is used to fix dearness allowance, to find real wages as money wage over C P I times one hundred, and to find the purchasing power of the rupee.
narration.kn: ತುಟ್ಟಿಭತ್ಯೆ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಲು, ನೈಜ ವೇತನ = ಹಣದ ವೇತನ ÷ CPI × 100 ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಲು ಮತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿಯ ಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಶಕ್ತಿ ತಿಳಿಯಲು CPI ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

heading.en: Real things are divided by CPI

body.en: Anything real (real wage, real income) = money value ÷ CPI × 100. Purchasing power of a rupee is just 100 ÷ CPI.

homework.en: Explain the steps in the construction of a consumer price index.

narration.en: Recap. CPI measures change in the cost of living of a class of people. Aggregate expenditure method: Σp₁q₀/Σp₀q₀ × 100. Family budget method: ΣIW/ΣW. Real wage = money wage × 100/CPI.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. CPI ಒಂದು ವರ್ಗದ ಜನರ ಜೀವನ ವೆಚ್ಚದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಮಷ್ಟಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ವಿಧಾನ: Σp₁q₀/Σp₀q₀ × 100. ಕುಟುಂಬ ಬಜೆಟ್ ವಿಧಾನ: ΣIW/ΣW. ನೈಜ ವೇತನ = ಹಣದ ವೇತನ × 100/CPI.
